response: Today, we're introducing Saved Views, a new way to work faster inside your projects. Instead of rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a list, you can now save the exact configuration you need and return to it in a single click. Saved Views is available today and included in all paid plans, so every subscriber gets access without any add-on or upgrade. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize by project, priority, status, assignee, or any combination that matches how your team actually works. Views aren't limited to personal use, either: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone looks at the same filtered list without repeating setup work. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or keeping an eye on a specific client's projects, Saved Views makes it easy to jump straight to what matters. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
